en: A multi-view color postcard with a red patterned border and the coat of arms of Turda in the center. Four photographs show different landmarks: an old stone church with tall narrow windows, a grand historic building surrounded by trees and a formal garden, a landscaped city park with paths and flowerbeds, and a tall stone obelisk monument set among greenery. In the middle, on a yellow panel, the name "TURDA" is printed in bold black letters beneath the city crest.
